The '''Sky Temple of Karsol''' was an ancient [[Jedi temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] built on [[Sakuub]], several days hike from [[Old Town (Sakuub)|Old Town]]. Despite being a famous tourist attraction, it was not discovered to be a Jedi temple until [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]] visited it in [[44 ABY]], as its makers caused its [[The Force/Legends|Force]] signature to be hidden as protection. While there, Jaina discovered the [[Sakuub Holocron]] in the ruins, as well as entered a [[Skirmish on Sakuub|skirmish]] with a [[Sakuubian]] criminal named [[Pharika]].
